title: The Four Princes
framing: Time passes, from infancy to adolescence.

bk-05-01.narration: Kaushalya bore Rama, Kaikeyi Bharata, and Sumitra Lakshmana and Shatrughna. The palace celebrated the four boys’ births.

bk-05-02.narration: The brothers grew up studying and learning to use weapons. Rama and Lakshmana were especially close, as were Bharata and Shatrughna.

bk-05-03.narration: As the princes became adolescents, Vishwamitra visited Dasharatha’s court. The king welcomed the sage respectfully and asked why he had come.
bk-05-03.speaker: Dasharatha
bk-05-03.dialogue: Revered sage, how may I serve you?
